title: The raytracer runs with several threads while a solver runs, from the renderer thread
author: Claude-JG
description: The raytracer can be started from the main thread and from the renderer thread; the one TaskManager is global, so while a solver uses the threads the raytracer falls back to one thread, and a raytracer started in the renderer thread during a solve crashes. The raytracer shall run in parallel to the solver with threads of its own.
releaseNotes: The raytracer renders on threads of its own (visualizationSettings.raytracer.numberOfThreads), independent of the threads of the solvers: it runs in parallel also while a solver runs, from a user function or from the renderer thread; the speed is unchanged. The persistent threads of exudyn.special.solver.StartPersistentThreads are no longer used by the raytracer. Test model raytracerDuringSolveTest.py.
